tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the signed-in user's scheduled daily tasks for a date, with their done state. Use this before marking a task so you have task IDs.

date.description: Date to list tasks for, as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: mark_task
tools.title: Mark task done or not done
tools.description: Mark one of the user's tasks as done (or undo it) for a specific date. Get the task ID from list_tasks.

task_id.description: ID of the task to update, from list_tasks.

done.description: true to mark the task done for that date, false to undo it.

date.description: Date to mark the task for, as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: add_task
tools.title: Add a task
tools.description: Add a daily task to the user's Punch routine. Optionally restrict it to weekdays (0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday); empty means every day.

emoji.description: A short emoji shown next to the task. Defaults to ✨.

days.description: Which weekdays the task repeats on (0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday). Omit or empty for every day.

tools.name: log_food
tools.title: Log a food entry
tools.description: Log food the user ate on a date with its nutrition totals (calories, protein, carbs, fiber, sugar). Values are totals for the amount eaten, not per 100 g.

calories.description: Total calories (kcal) for the amount eaten.

protein.description: Total protein in grams. Defaults to 0.

carbs.description: Total carbohydrates in grams. Defaults to 0.

fiber.description: Total fiber in grams. Defaults to 0.

sugar.description: Total sugar in grams. Defaults to 0.

grams.description: Amount eaten in grams or ml. Defaults to 100.

unit.description: Unit for the amount. Defaults to 'g'.

emoji.description: A short emoji shown next to the entry. Defaults to 🍽️.

date.description: Date the food was eaten, as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: log_activity
tools.title: Log an activity
tools.description: Log a workout or activity the user did (name, duration). Calories burned are estimated from the user's profile weight and gender unless you pass calories_burned.

minutes.description: How long the activity lasted, in minutes.

calories_burned.description: Calories burned. Omit to estimate from the user's profile (MET × weight × time, lower for females).

emoji.description: A short emoji shown next to the entry. Defaults to 🏃.

date.description: Date the activity was done, as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time. Defaults to today (UTC).

tools.name: daily_summary
tools.title: Daily summary
tools.description: Get the user's Punch day: tasks done vs scheduled (with missed task titles), nutrition totals vs targets, and calories burned from activity.

date.description: Date to summarize, as YYYY-MM-DD in the user's local time. Defaults to today (UTC).
